messages:
Sam: quick follow-up from the AttrV2 RFC. we need to decide on an operational pattern for hot extension keys and cost attribution when enrichment is late. aim: keep queryable surface small, avoid cardinality blowup, and make billing accurate.
Riley: +1. concrete problems: 1) arbitrary extensions break indexes, 2) enrichment can attach cost_key after sampler dropped traffic, 3) users want to filter by model_id/route cheaply.
Anoop: proposal sketch: CORE columns = tenant_id, trace_id, cost_key (nullable), model_id_id (int), route_id (int), seq_len, ts, cost_claim_status. extensions -> compressed blob up to 2KB inline; overflow -> object store with pointer.
Dana: agree but add: a dictionary service that maps hot string keys (model_id/route) to compact ints. have a background compactor that evicts cold entries. keep reverse map for ad-hoc queries.
Sam: how do we promote a key into "hot"? we can't rely on ad-hoc schema changes.
Riley: sidecar catalog: a service that tracks frequency of extension keys and exposes an API to promote top-N keys to first-class columns. promotion is a metadata op, no schema change, we encode promoted columns as an integer slot in the row. clients use the slot id.
Anoop: sidecar must have guardrails: min-frequency threshold, hysteresis window (7d), and per-org caps to avoid noisy tenants promoting lots of keys.
Dana: billing/cost attribution: three options: require cost_key at ingress, move sampling post-enrich (expensive), or allow enrichment to emit a tiny indexed cost_claim sentinel (trace_id->cost_key, ttl 7d). i favor the cost_claim sentinel.
Sam: sentinel sounds practical. implement in a fast KV store (low latency reads for joins) and make billing lookup consult it if cost_key is missing on the envelope. if sentinel arrives after billing window, mark cost_claim_status=late and schedule backfill.
Riley: monitoring: billing_match_rate (tokens with cost_key at billing time), cost_claim_latency P95, extension_blob_growth. alert thresholds: billing_match_rate <= 99.5% for committed accounts, cost_claim_latency P95 > 10s, blob growth > 25% w/w.
Anoop: migration plan: dual-write V1+V2 for 8 weeks. server-side translation map for legacy keys for 9 months and a client-side shim library for 6 months. expose translation metrics to owning teams.
Dana: security: run lightweight PII scans on extensions top keys and redact before storing. log redaction counts and expose per-org redaction alerts.
Sam: owners: Sam -> rollout doc + dashboard definitions; Riley -> sidecar catalog + promotion heuristics; Anoop -> cost_claim prototype + KV store; Dana -> SDK shim + PII checks. i'll draft the addendum and open tickets.
ingest-bot: created task ORG-9820 "AttrV2: hotkey promotion + cost_claim sentinel" assigned to Sam, Riley, Anoop, Dana. :white_check_mark:
Sam: thanks all, will post the addendum link shortly.
